posts.title: Building AI agents that ship — lessons from the field
posts.description: Lessons learned building and deploying AI systems across four companies — from guardrails and monitoring to shipping fast.
keyTakeaways: The agent is 20% of the work — guardrails, monitoring, fallbacks are the other 80%
Every successful AI feature started with a written plan
Ship behind a feature flag, watch metrics, iterate fast
Open source is the best forcing function for quality
